perfect-competition-side-by-side.alt: Side-by-side graphs. The market's demand and supply set the price PM; the firm takes it as a horizontal line d = MR = AR = P and produces qF where MR = MC, at the lowest point of ATC, earning zero economic profit.

perfect-competition-long-run.alt: Side-by-side graphs: market demand rises from D1 to D2, raising the price to P2 and giving the firm a profit at q2; new firms enter, supply shifts from S1 to S2, and the price returns to P1 at the lowest point of ATC, with a larger market quantity.
